info.name: MangaFlow API - Complete Workflow
info.description:
Complete Postman collection generated from the mounted backend routes.

Setup:
1. Start the backend on http://localhost:3001.
2. Import this collection and MangaFlow-Local.postman_environment.json.
3. Run one role login under Auth, then use Canonical Happy Path actor switches to select activeAccessToken.
4. Run create requests in order; the collection-level test captures workflow IDs for later requests.

Canonical rules included by this collection:
- Proposal authoring is Mangaka-only; Editor reviews and acts but does not create proposals.
- Material status is a top-level field. APPROVED requires the assigned Tantou; rate data is server-resolved and snapshotted.
- Chapter readiness is read from the canonical readiness endpoint.
- Comment resolve/reopen use workflow endpoints, not PATCH status, and require the assigned Tantou.
- Rate table management is Admin-only; Mangaka/Editor can only read active rate options.

Request descriptions identify the expected actor role. Negative Authorization & State and Deprecated Compatibility folders are intentionally executable checks.

exec: const id = entity.id ?? entity._id ?? data.id ?? data._id;
